Overview of Graduate Programmes
View all Graduate Programmes
Since the establishment of School of Biological Sciences (SBS) in 2001, we have always focused on equipping students with the skills and knowledge essential for today’s global environment.
SBS offers a stimulating environment and diverse areas of research in biological and biomedical sciences. We promote interdisciplinary research through collaboration across boundaries and are committed to doing excellent research and delivering high-level education to our students.
We currently offer four different graduate programmes:
PhD (Research)
MSc (Research)
MSc (Coursework) in Biomedical Data Science
MSc (Coursework) in BioBusiness and BioEntrepreneurship
The PhD and MSc Research programmes require the students to perform original and novel research and submit a thesis for examination at the end of their candidature. It takes typically 4 years to complete the PhD and ~1.5 to 2 years for MSc.

MSc in Biomedical Data Science
The Master of Science in Biomedical Data Science is the first graduate programme in the Asia-Pacific region offering data science training for specific application in the biomedical domain. The programme is a joint collaboration between Nanyang Technological University (NTU) and the Agency for Science Technology and Research (A*STAR) Singapore.

MSc in BioBusiness and BioEntrepreneurship
The Master of Science in BioBusiness and BioEntrepreneurship is a cutting-edge programme bridging science and business. Available as a one-year full-time or two-year part-time course, it equips scientists, business professionals, and aspiring bio-entrepreneurs with expertise in biomedical sciences, biotechnology, and business, empowering them to commercialise breakthroughs, lead in biotech and healthcare, and drive market-changing innovations.
Find out more
MSc in Chinese Medicine
The Master of Science in Chinese Medicine is Singapore’s first postgraduate Chinese Medicine degree. Designed for healthcare professionals and TCM practitioners, the programme integrates traditional Chinese Medicine with modern science, equipping graduates with advanced clinical, research, and integrative healthcare skills to meet the evolving needs of global healthcare.
